properties.name: Someone who did not build the system can be told where a new piece of work belongs
properties.statement: A person inheriting a mature design must be able to ask "we need to add this — where does it go?" and be answered from the graph: which existing part should own it, what the change would touch, which decisions already govern that area and must not be casually contradicted, what intent it must not break, and who authored the reasoning so they can be asked. Answering "what is this system and what has been decided" is necessary but not sufficient; the requirement is satisfied only when the second question — where and how do I add to it — is also answered, and when the answer says honestly which parts of the real system the design does not cover.
